author_note: I read only the 13 workflow YAML contracts in workflows/, scripts/workflow_registry.py, the brief and check_format.py. Each gold call follows from contract text quoted in its evidence: input artifacts and incompatible inputs, minimum sample counts, COBRA's genes>samples rule, SAMBAR's 2<=kmin<=kmax<=samples, DRAGON/LIONESS-DRAGON same-sample and 20,000,000-value limits (recomputed as F(F-1)/2 x samples), CONDOR's regulator-gene edge-list input and one-community partitions, and the handoffs DRAGON, BONOBO and COBRA->LIONESS refuse. Results no contract produces (overlapping or graded membership, lagged or state-transition dynamics, neighbour-aware spatial results) are DECLINE; per-sample or per-group results from time-course or spatial samples are DO. Items were shuffled with random.Random(20261027) before ids were assigned.
